summary_en: Jumbo Co., Ltd. launched a tender offer for all outstanding common shares and warrant securities of I-ne Co., Ltd. (TSE Prime: 4933). The offer commenced on November 20, 2026, targeting common stock and five series of warrants issued between 2019 and 2025.
title_en: Notice Regarding Commencement of Tender Offer for Shares and Warrant Securities of I-ne Co., Ltd. (Securities Code: 4933) by Jumbo Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
Jumbo Co., Ltd. announced the commencement of a tender offer on November 20, 2026, to acquire all outstanding common shares and warrant securities of I-ne Co., Ltd., a company listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market (Securities Code: 4933). The offer targets ordinary shares as well as five series of warrants issued between May 2019 and July 2025, including warrants with exercise periods extending through 2030.

The tender offer was conducted pursuant to the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. This announcement was made by Jumbo Co., Ltd. as the offeror based on a request from I-ne Co., Ltd., and was published in accordance with the applicable regulatory requirements. The specific terms regarding offer price, number of shares to be acquired, tender period duration, and other detailed conditions were not disclosed in the initial announcement pages provided.
